calls.statement: SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, sum(closing_units) AS units FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-23' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.category, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus, sum(fs.closing_units) AS units, min(fs.closing_units) AS min_units, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_rows, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_rows, max(s.store_id) AS max_store, sum(CASE WHEN cs.close_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_store_rows
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24' AS in_window, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id >= 900 THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_900_plus, sum(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_zz, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpositive_qty_lines, min(f.sale_date) AS min_d, max(f.sale_date) AS max_d, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending
),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7 THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_prior4,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 27 AND params.week_ending THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_incl4
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.category, c.closing_units, s.units_prior4, ROUND(s.units_prior4/4.0,1) AS avg_wk,
       ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_prior4 / 4.0), 1) AS weeks_of_cover,
       ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_incl4 / 4.0), 1) AS woc_alt_incl_week
FROM closing c LEFT JOIN sold s ON s.category = c.category
ORDER BY c.category
